t: The Erbauer multi-material drill and screwdriver bit set provides comprehensive drilling and fastening solutions with 69 pieces suitable for wood, metal and masonry applications. This kit includes masonry drill bits, HSS metal bits, wood bits, sockets and mixed screwdriver bits in multiple lengths and profiles covering most driving requirements. Optimised tip geometry ensures efficient performance, whilst the set fits any chuck 10mm or larger, making it compatible with most major power tool brands. Supplied in a durable polypropylene organiser case with a 75mm screw guide included for organised storage and easy access on site.
b: Contents: 5 Masonry Drill Bits, 13 HSS Drill Bits, 6 Wood Bits, 5 Sockets, 39 Screwdriver Bits & Screw Guide.
Suitable Fits Any Chuck 10mm or Larger
